description: Red de estaciones permanentes GNSS is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by ogc.larioja.org. The network of permanent GNSS stations of the Autonomous Community of La Rioja is a free public service for receivers that allows correction in real time or post-processing and obtain centimetric precisions in three-dimensional positioning. The network has five reference stations distributed throughout the territory of La Rioja. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "GNSS permanent station network" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include IDErioja, Gobierno de La Rioja, GNSS. The listing shows 3 download or service links in WFS, WMS, GEOJSON. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
